consequence.statement: Operators who do nothing are unaffected: the change only adds an optional way to specify the service-account name when running `flux create tenant`.

assertion.statement: The `flux create tenant` command gained the ability to configure the service-account name (fluxcd/flux2 PR #5402, released in flux 2.7.0).

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence names the `flux create tenant` command but not the new option/flag (or its spelling) used to set the service-account name, so the subject cannot be pinned to an exact cli-flag identity.; applicability: The change is a new opt-in option of the `flux` CLI; whether an environment is exposed depends on the operator actually running `flux create tenant`, which no static environment input (chart values, manifests, flags, resources) carries.
